tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background behind cards (main canvas). Never put body text on it smaller than 13px; use surface for content.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sidebar, header, menus, dialogs, chart backgrounds.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Inputs and search fields at rest; table header rows.

tokens.name: surface-muted
tokens.usage: Hover fill for rows and menu items; bullet-chart track; chip fill.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Dark bands (zohelo.com footer, reversed logo ground, tooltips).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Card and section borders, sidebar and header dividers.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, buttons, segmented controls). Meets 1.5:1 against surface; controls also carry a text label.

tokens.name: line-subtle
tokens.usage: Row separators inside cards and tables.

tokens.name: grid
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines (solid, 1px). Zero line uses series-reference-light.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, titles, values on surface/canvas/surface-muted (17.7:1 on surface).

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, legend labels, table cells (10.3:1 on surface).

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: subtitles, breadcrumbs, inactive nav, chart notes (7.6:1 on surface).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata only: periods, sources, axis tick labels, 'wkrótce' (4.8:1 on surface, 4.5:1 on canvas). Never for anything the reader must act on.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Icons of unavailable items only (exempt from contrast as inactive). Never for text that carries meaning.

tokens.name: on-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on surface-inverse and on accent fills.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one UI accent: primary buttons, links, focus ring, active nav bar, selected segmented control border. Not a data colour (8.3:1 on surface).

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Text of the active nav item on accent-tint; link hover.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Active nav item fill, kind tags, selected chips, open menu trigger.

tokens.name: accent-tint-line
tokens.usage: Border of selected chips and the 'revised' status tag.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every focusable element and on label:focus-within for search fields. 8.3:1 on surface, 7.8:1 on canvas.

tokens.name: series-1
tokens.usage: Data: the hero series (Polska) and single-series charts. Never for text.

tokens.name: series-2
tokens.usage: Data: second series.

tokens.name: series-3
tokens.usage: Data: third series. Below 3:1 on surface: always pair with direct labels or a table view.

tokens.name: series-4
tokens.usage: Data: fourth series. Below 3:1: direct labels required.

tokens.name: series-5
tokens.usage: Data: fifth series. Below 3:1: direct labels required. A 6th+ series folds into 'Pozostałe' or small multiples.

tokens.name: series-context
tokens.usage: Data: comparison series behind the hero (other countries, other regions, past period). 3.4:1 on surface.

tokens.name: series-reference
tokens.usage: Data: reference marks (EU average bar, Polska = 100 line, sum bar in waterfall).

tokens.name: series-reference-light
tokens.usage: Zero/baseline rule and dumbbell connectors.

tokens.name: band
tokens.usage: Target/normal range band (e.g. NBP 1.5–3.5%). Always drawn with band-edge dashed edges, because the fill alone is 1.4:1.

tokens.name: band-edge
tokens.usage: Dashed 1px edges of a band; legend swatch border of the band.

tokens.name: seq-1
tokens.usage: Ordinal ramp class 1 (lowest). Binned maps and heatmaps start here, never lighter (2.06:1 on surface). Text on it: ink.

tokens.name: seq-2
tokens.usage: Ordinal ramp class 2. Text on it: ink.

tokens.name: seq-3
tokens.usage: Ordinal ramp class 3. No text on it (neither ink nor white reaches 4.5:1); use a 4-class ramp (seq-1, seq-2, seq-4, seq-5) when cells carry values.

tokens.name: seq-4
tokens.usage: Ordinal ramp class 4. Text on it: on-inverse (6.6:1).

tokens.name: seq-5
tokens.usage: Ordinal ramp class 5 (highest). Text on it: on-inverse (9.9:1).

tokens.name: div-negative
tokens.usage: Diverging: below zero/reference (spadek). Always with a legend and a zero line; never as a judgement of good/bad.

tokens.name: div-mid
tokens.usage: Diverging: neutral midpoint for continuous diverging scales.

tokens.name: div-positive
tokens.usage: Diverging: above zero/reference (wzrost).

tokens.name: status-current-bg
tokens.usage: 'Aktualne' data-freshness tag background.

tokens.name: status-current-fg
tokens.usage: 'Aktualne' tag text (7.0:1 on its background); also the 'Kiedy' label in chart guidance.

tokens.name: status-current-dot
tokens.usage: 'Aktualne' tag dot.

tokens.name: status-current-line
tokens.usage: 'Aktualne' tag border.

tokens.name: status-preliminary-bg
tokens.usage: 'Wstępne' tag background.

tokens.name: status-preliminary-fg
tokens.usage: 'Wstępne' tag text (6.7:1).

tokens.name: status-preliminary-dot
tokens.usage: 'Wstępne' tag dot.

tokens.name: status-preliminary-line
tokens.usage: 'Wstępne' tag border.

tokens.name: status-revised-bg
tokens.usage: 'Zrewidowane' tag background.

tokens.name: status-revised-fg
tokens.usage: 'Zrewidowane' tag text.

tokens.name: status-error-fg
tokens.usage: Error text in chart-card error state; 'Unikaj' label (8.3:1 on surface).

tokens.name: status-error-bg
tokens.usage: Error state fill.

tokens.name: status-error-line
tokens.usage: Error state border.

tokens.name: sample-bg
tokens.usage: 'Dane przykładowe' badge background.

tokens.name: sample-fg
tokens.usage: 'Dane przykładowe' badge text.

tokens.name: sample-line
tokens.usage: 'Dane przykładowe' badge border.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind the phone menu drawer and dialogs.

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: zohelo.com hero only; one per page.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: The page's h1 in every portal (24px/32px below 768px).

styles.name: kpi-hero
styles.usage: Single hero number on an indicator page; proportional figures.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Chart-card and panel titles (h2/h3). States the finding.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: Inflacja wróciła do pasma celu NBP.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Chart subtitles, legends, sources, KPI context.

styles.name: label-caps
styles.usage: Sidebar group labels and kind tags, uppercase.

styles.name: chart-text
styles.usage: Axis ticks and data labels inside charts; the minimum size for any chart text (10px only for dense pyramid/waterfall ticks on desktop).

styles.name: tabular
styles.usage: Numbers in tables and column-aligned lists: add font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap inside tags; legend swatch gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between controls in a group; card title to subtitle.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Sidebar padding; gap inside cards between blocks.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Grid gap between cards; phone page gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card inner padding (horizontal).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between page header and content.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter (main area).

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Space before the footer; between dashboard sections.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Board padding on design-system boards; zohelo.com section spacing.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Kind tags, kbd keys, chart tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, segmented controls, nav items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Menus, command palette, KPI tiles inside charts.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status tags, filter chips, sample-data badge.

tokens.name: shadow-menu
tokens.usage: Dropdown and action menus.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Command palette and dialogs.

tokens.name: shadow-drawer
tokens.usage: Phone menu drawer.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: Cards: no shadow; borders separate surfaces.

tokens.name: header-h
tokens.usage: Top bar height (56px on phone).

tokens.name: sidebar-w
tokens.usage: Expanded sidebar width.

tokens.name: rail-w
tokens.usage: Collapsed sidebar (icon rail) width.

tokens.name: drawer-w
tokens.usage: Phone menu drawer width.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the main content column next to the sidebar.

tokens.name: site-max
tokens.usage: Max content width in the site shell (zohelo.com).

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, nav items on desktop.

tokens.name: control-h-touch
tokens.usage: Every control below 768px.

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Nav and action icons, 1.5px stroke.

tokens.name: bp-phone
tokens.usage: At or below: phone layout (drawer menu, one column, 44px controls, phone chart variants).

tokens.name: bp-tablet
tokens.usage: At or below: chart rows stack to one column.

tokens.name: bp-desktop
tokens.usage: At or below: sidebar collapses to the icon rail; KPI tiles two per row.

tokens.name: bp-wide
tokens.usage: Design reference width for desktop mockups.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky top bar.

tokens.name: z-menu
tokens.usage: Dropdowns, action menus, tooltips.

tokens.name: z-drawer
tokens.usage: Phone drawer and its scrim.

tokens.name: z-dialog
tokens.usage: Command palette, dialogs.
